definitions.explanation: A natural fiber from the cotton plant, used for making fabric and textiles.

examples.japanese: {木綿|もめん}{豆腐|どうふ}を{買|か}った。
examples.notes: {木綿|もめん}{豆腐|どうふ} is firm tofu

examples.japanese: {木綿|もめん}の{生地|きじ}は{涼|すず}しい。
{夏|なつ}は{木綿|もめん}の{服|ふく}が{涼|すず}しくて{着|き}やすいので、よく{着|き}ている。
examples.english: In summer I often wear cotton clothes because they're cool and comfortable.

notes:
{木綿|もめん} refers to cotton as a material.

COMMON USES:
- {木綿|もめん}の{服|ふく}: cotton clothing
- {木綿|もめん}{糸|いと}: cotton thread
- {木綿|もめん}{豆腐|どうふ}: firm tofu (vs. {絹|きぬ}ごし{豆腐|どうふ})

RELATED TERMS:
- {綿|わた}: cotton (raw/wadding)
- {絹|きぬ}: silk
- {麻|あさ}: hemp, linen
- コットン: cotton (loanword)

Note: Also read as もくめん in some compounds.
